limitations: Broader colour Options, duplicate filter and duplicate-colours parent rows remain Partial; no parent, duplicate claim or alias receives completion credit.

Normal canvas base is white or the imported active override colour. Arbitrary QSS stylesheet palettes remain outside these leaves. The separately banked native colour-set controls receive no additional credit from this duplicate-colour slice; broader QColorDialog topology and application/OS palette workflows remain outside scope.

Native checker is clipped to the actual image box and shares the existing greenscreen preference. The native painter test isolates the same background operation with a transparent probe while the real frozen PNG/JPEG metadata and real pair switch select the policy; no file media or relationship is modified.

Actual Qt Options recording drives its real page controls and UpdateOptions, serialization/reopen and abandoned page draft. Full Qt modal parent Cancel was not recorded; native regression separately invokes actual owned Options Cancel/Apply and retired-owner/successor boundaries.
Validation scope is Linux only; Windows and macOS are deferred.

Qt final real opaqueB/hover-layout screenshot differs from native controlled transparent-probe painter states; no whole-filter pixel equality, decoded-image fidelity or arbitrary palette contrast is inferred.

Default black follows the recorded Qt Canvas role; universal readability across arbitrary saved/custom/QSS palettes is not claimed. Slint and Qt font metrics, widget styling and filter topology differ.

The two role11 override captures naturally restore real opaqueB media and additional slow comparison results while the existing owner timer runs; they validate status colour/visibility only, not recorded background-probe or comparison-score equality.
